mapper.select: SELECT dul.id, ucg.pkg_config_group_id, pcg.pkg, pcg.pvc, pcg.svc, ucg.user_id, pcg.name, pcg.config_group_type, pcg.config_group_id from ods_user_config_group_diversion ucg left join ods_pkg_config_group_diversion pcg on (ucg.pkg_config_group_id = pcg.id) LEFT JOIN dim_user_lab dul on (dul.pkg = pcg.pkg and dul.pvc = pcg.pvc and dul.svc = pcg.svc and dul.user_id = ucg.user_id and dul.pkg_config_group_id = ucg.pkg_config_group_id and dul.config_group_type = pcg.config_group_type and dul.config_group_id = pcg.config_group_id ) where ucg.id = #{userLabId}
